hypothesis: The N=64 reference level for force replicates on fresh seeds 24-26 (data_seed 0, 4 layers, d_model=64, e in [0, 0.5], m2 in [0.1, 1], 3000 steps, best-of-3 controls). Earlier seeds 20-23 gave a final best-layer force margin of 0.215-0.261, trained force R2 of about 0.68-0.74 and force control R2 of about 0.45-0.51. This arm anchors the paired N=128 and N=256 seeds 24-26 decomposition into trained-R2 and control components.
expected_if_true: In all 3 seeds: final best-layer force margin >= 0.18 with beats_control true, trained force R2 >= 0.65, and normalised accel_step margin in [0.60, 0.78].
expected_if_false: In >= 2 of 3 seeds, the final force margin is < 0.15 or trained force R2 is < 0.62. That would mean the N=64 level from seeds 20-23 does not generalise, and earlier cross-N contrasts rest on an unrepresentative reference.
